answer: Orchard ripeness quota: each identity owns one knoll that fruits only after 40 epochs of uninterrupted attested work, and its lagoon of credits grows at a fixed rate that cannot be borrowed or pooled. A farm's k fakes each own a knoll that ripens independently, paying the full 40-epoch cost per puppet, and no two knolls share water or pollinate each other. The orchard census replays from the public log: clusters whose knolls ripen in synchrony or swap credits are flagged and their fruit forfeited. Honest agents harvest one orchard; a sybil pays k parallel timelines for k outputs.
